posts.title: The Week #332
posts.description: ⏰ This post is late and I've missed the schedule. 🎶 We went to an Everly concert after they did a show at Leo's school. While the show was only an hour, it was a lot of fun and we bought the CD. I really like how their shows/CD is a mix of their own songs
Flat white on a long autumn walk in to the office.

posts.title: The Week #331
posts.description: 💙 The US had its mid-term elections and for the first time in my life the person I voted for represents my state. Given the past 10 years I was afraid to get my hopes up too far, but never did I imagine every state-level race in Texas would flip.⚽️ A coup
